decisions.reason: Because this training programme builds directly on the firm's service strengths, was visibly promoted on its own page, and requires relatively limited incremental resources to maintain, management is likely to keep it and justify the prior commitment.

This accessory is close to the installed-base business and supports the firm's modular equipment logic, so despite only modest public commitment management still has reason to retain it unless weakness becomes unmistakably persistent.

Hybrid additive post-processing sits far from the firm's established offer and was only lightly signalled publicly, so disappointing results are easier to accept as a failed experiment and resources are more likely to be redeployed.

A high-speed CNC milling machine line with several models implies heavy development investment, strong visible commitment, and clear strategic importance for the firm's future-oriented production portfolio, which strongly favors persistence.

The automatic tool change system fits the core promise of efficient, reliable machining and was given a dedicated product presence, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than admit an early reversal.
